## Session-start digest excerpt

This fixture stands in for the Firstmate session-start digest a coordinator sees at startup, including stale captain memory.

captain.md:
- Prefer a discuss-plan-work cycle (gsd-discuss → gsd-plan → gsd-work) before dispatching feature work. Discuss: firstmate interviews for goals, users, expectations, non-goals, constraints, risks, and acceptance evidence, scaled to ambiguity. Plan: Astra high produces the plan artifact; wait for explicit implementation authorization. Work: Grok implements; then Astra high does one bounded review of the finished output before firstmate calls the PR ready.
